# TPC-Havoc Q10_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM customer AS c INNER JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey INNER JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey INNER JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-10-01' AS DATE) AND o.o_orderdate < CAST('1993-10-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH' AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_phone, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_comment ORDER BY revenue DESC
```
